text:
emma: Heads up - enterprise prospect asked: can we do a sealed on-prem POC with monthly security-only updates, signed bundles, HSM integration, and courier delivery for initial install? Need feasibility + short SOW-friendly POC plan.
raj: Feasible. We support signed immutable bundles, offline JWT activation tokens, and HSM-wrapped keys. Monthly security patches ok for runtime. Major model/quant updates should be quarterly.
kevin: Ops note: if we handle signing + courier coordination it's billable. Recommend a per-bundle handling fee plus an onboarding workshop line in SOW.
nana: Quick 10-day POC sketch for SOW:
- Day 0: Ship signed test bundle + SBOM + verify script via encrypted SSD courier.
- Day 1: Onsite install with our SE assisting; run signature verification.
- Day 2: Baseline prompts (50) and latency checks.
- Day 4: HSM wrap/unwrap validation or proxy test.
- Day 6: Apply security-only delta patch and smoke test.
- Day 8: Rollback test and handoff runbook.
Deliverables: runbook, signed SBOM, SHA256 manifest, verification logs.
raj: Packaging details: OCI preferred for operator installs; tar.gz signed bundles for strict airgap. Bundles include runtime, model shards, manifest.json, sbom.json, signature.sig. We can produce a trimmed quantized POC bundle ~2.5-3GB.
kevin: Transfer logistics: if initial window < bundle size, courier SSD for initial payload, then SCP via bastion for deltas. We'll provide verify scripts and atomic-install pattern (write-to-temp -> swap).
emma: Example CLI to include in runbook?
raj: Yes, add this snippet:
```
redwood-agent install --bundle /tmp/rw-bundle.tar.gz --verify-key /opt/keys/redwood.pub
redwood-agent activate --token /tmp/offline.jwt --ca /etc/redwood/ca.pem
```
Activation token is short-lived and handed via secure channel.
ops-bot: Reminder - include emergency model-fix SLA clause in SOW for critical regressions.
kevin: Next steps: ask customer for HSM vendor/model, EDR policy, exact transfer window, and courier vs SCP preference. I'll draft SOW line items and ballpark.
emma: Great — I'll request details and share the POC skeleton. Thanks :thumbsup:
